# llms.txt for Mobile Device Testing Tools
# URL: https://mobiledevice.github.io
# Description: Free browser-based diagnostic suite for testing smartphone hardware features

## Website Overview
This is a client-side web application that provides 14+ hardware diagnostic tests for mobile devices. All tests run locally in the browser with no app installation, no account creation, and no cost.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://mobiledevice.github.io/): Main entry point for all hardware tests.

## Diagnostic Tools
- [Camera Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/camera-test): Front and rear camera inspection.
- [Microphone Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/mic-test): Audio input and microphone check.
- [Speaker Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/speaker-test): Audio output and frequency response testing.
- [Touch Screen Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/swipe-test): Multi-touch and screen gesture calibration.
- [Display & Dead Pixel Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/display-test): Screen pattern, color, and pixel diagnostics.
- [Vibration Motor Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/vibration-test): Haptic motor response check.
- [Motion Sensor Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/sensor-test): Accelerometer and gyroscope diagnostic.
- [Battery Health Check](https://mobiledevice.github.io/battery-test): Battery status and charge indicator.
- [GPS & Location Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/gps-test): Geolocation accuracy test.
- [Bluetooth Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/bluetooth-test): Web Bluetooth connectivity test.
- [Network Speed Test](https://mobiledevice.github.io/network-speed-test): Connection speed diagnostic.
- [Mobile Device Detector](https://mobiledevice.github.io/detector): User-agent and hardware feature detection.

## Key Features
- **Zero Setup**: No app installation required - https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- **Privacy-First**: Tests run locally, data never leaves your device - https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- **Free**: No tiers, trials, or paywalls - https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- **Cross-Platform**: Works on any modern mobile browser - https://mobiledevice.github.io/

## Common Use Cases
- Pre-purchase phone inspection: https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- Post-repair verification: https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- Warranty claim documentation: https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- New device out-of-box testing: https://mobiledevice.github.io/
- Hardware vs. software troubleshooting: https://mobiledevice.github.io/

## API Information
This is a client-side web application that uses browser APIs:
- MediaDevices API (camera/microphone)
- Web Audio API (speaker tests)
- Touch Events API (screen tests)
- Generic Sensor API (motion sensors)
- Battery Status API
- Geolocation API
- Web Bluetooth API
- Network Information API

All tests are available at: https://mobiledevice.github.io/
